'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Barry Alperstein DS ISB Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Barry Alperstein]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents]]
* '''Username:''' MrFromMars
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.1]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
